commentary: Directional accuracy (49.3%) near 50% is mathematically consistent with Eugene Fama's Weak-Form Efficient Market Hypothesis (EMH) for liquid commodity futures. However, the deep LSTM + Attention network captures multi-scale volatility clustering and non-linear momentum, achieving an R² of 0.528 and reducing test MAPE by -151.2% compared to the linear ARIMA baseline (14.16% vs 5.64%).
